23.  The  Commission  shall  inform  aggrieved  persons,
witnesses and other informants, who provide information to the
Commission, of the potential use of any information provided
by them and their right to directly refer matters to relevant
authorities, including their right to report serious crimes to
the  relevant  law  enforcement  or  prosecuting  authorities  of
Sri Lanka and of the availability of any mechanisms through
which they may make claims for administrative relief.
